title: GTA 5 vs GTA 6: the numbers don't lie #gta6 #shorts
description: GTA V (2013) vs GTA VI (2026), side by side. Day-one figure for GTA VI is preorders + first-day sales per Take-Two.

scenes.say: GTA 5 versus GTA 6. It's not even close.
Six wanted stars instead of five. Twenty bucks more at launch. Two leads, Jason and Lucia, instead of three. And day-one money? Not close.
The sixth star hasn't been in a main GTA since GTA 4.
So which one's better? GTA 5 or GTA 6?
